SynoPkgAudiobookshelf **2.37.1-0001**

2.37.1-0001
- Initial catalog preview with DSM main-menu OIDC sign-in and an install-selected read-only media share; grant package-account Read access separately in DSM.
- Published CLI/templates/SDK/App 0.20.0, executor/v0.20.0 and UI 0.12.5; npm lock integrity verified and check/build/inspect findings=[].
- Fresh installation, administrator sign-in, synthetic media playback, native stop/start and uninstall cleanup verified; broader identity evidence retains its documented scope.
- Named App data volumes are retained during uninstall. Native-client support and immediate session revocation are not certified.
